articles.title: Longer-dated US Treasury yields climb as Iran and US restart military attacks

The bond market reacted to these signals, reflecting economic uncertainty.

articles.content: ITC Infotech will merge with Happiest Minds Technologies creating a significant IT services entity. This merger aims to establish an AI-first enterprise with a substantial turnover by FY28. ITC Infotech is acquiring a significant stake from Happiest Minds promoters as a precursor. The combined entity will become India's eleventh largest listed IT services player by revenue. Upon completion, the merged company is proposed to be listed on Indian stock exchanges.

articles.title: Sebi bars Tarapur Transformers, promoters from markets for 5 years in fund diversion case
articles.content: Sebi barred nine entities, including Tarapur Transformers and its promoters, from securities markets for up to five years. The regulator found fund diversion through interest-free loans and fictitious transactions in company books. Rajendra Kumar Choudhary, a promoter, received a five-year ban and a Rs 30 lakh fine. Other entities faced three-year market bans for their involvement in these fraudulent activities.

articles.title: Foreign buying in Indian stocks hits 23-month high in August, RBI data shows
articles.content: In August, foreign investors channeled an impressive $3.1 billion into Indian equities, marking the largest monthly inflow in nearly two years. This surge in investment was bolstered by robust domestic earnings and proactive measures from the central bank. However, despite this positive trend, annual outflows are still trending towards a record high, with broader markets seeing an upswing even as major stocks faced declines.

articles.title: Sebi slaps Rs 25 lakh fine on Citrus Check Inns directors
articles.content: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) has imposed a Rs 25 lakh penalty on three directors of Citrus Check Inns for disobeying its orders. The firm had unlawfully gathered funds from investors despite Sebi's prohibitory instructions. The directors claimed these collections were unintentional, attributed to agents and automatic setups. However, Sebi dismissed their argument, holding the directors accountable for the agents' actions.

articles.title: Chinese AI chipmaker Enflame aims to raise $908 million after setting Shanghai IPO price
articles.content: Enflame Technology, a prominent Chinese AI chip manufacturer, is set to raise over $900 million through its IPO in Shanghai. The firm intends to confront Nvidia's stronghold in the AI chip sector, channeling the raised capital into sophisticated chip development and software initiatives. Investor pre-subscriptions for the IPO are slated to commence on Wednesday.

articles.title: India 10-year bond yield sees biggest monthly rise in FY27 on rising rate hike bets
articles.content: On Monday, Indian government bonds faced a notable drop, reflecting market unease. The benchmark 10-year yield marked its sharpest monthly increase of the fiscal year, fueled by rising oil prices and the Reserve Bank of India's aggressive monetary policy. Additionally, the Federal Reserve's recent indications added pressure on the bond market. This downturn raises serious concerns regarding India's inflation prospects and government financial stability.
